caption: the psp prequel that explains everything - three keyblade apprentices, three campaigns, one tragedy.
about: Kingdom hearts birth by sleep (2010) is the prequel that rebuilt the series' whole timeline: terra, ventus and aqua chase the vanished master xehanort across disney worlds a decade before sora's story, and each of the three campaigns reframes the same events until the last chapter locks the tragedy in place. The command-deck combat system remains one of the series' best action kits, and mirage arena adds local multiplayer boss hunts.
No windows build exists, so the platform is psp - played through ppsspp, with the rom sourced from romsfun and the emulator documented on the software shelf.
